actionResult.summary: 实现 exact-candidate re-verification lifecycle：bare verify 保持只读；verify --retry 仅在 completed Apply + failed Verification + exact candidate unchanged 时合法；失败 publication 进入 fingerprint-addressed immutable history；Reader 验证 same-origin/same-candidate/same-selection lineage；不新增 Change/Action/Run，不修改 timeout/concurrency/scheduler。
